subject: Renewal negotiation — upgrade 16→32 GPUs (term + throughput adjustment)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altosys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Mills <sara.mills@altosys.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 09:12 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — reserved pool expansion request

Hi Monica,

As we approach our May renewal for the reserved GPU pool, we'd like to discuss upgrading our committed capacity from 16→32 GPUs. Over the quarter our ingestion rates have increased and our latency tail is pushing customers into degraded experiences — the extra headroom and dedicated KV cache should help.

High-level asks:
- Targeted go-live: 2027-06-01
- Revised per-hour reserved rate we can lock for the 12-month renewal term
- Throughput target: sustain 220 tokens/sec avg across peak partitioning (previously agreed SLA was 120)
- Any onboarding/one-time migration assistance and estimated costs

Can you share a provisional pricing and any throughput guarantees you can offer? Procurement is copied — they will need an estimate for the PO.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering, Altos Systems
liam.oconnor@altosys.com
+1 (415) 555-0113
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altosys.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 11:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — reserved pool expansion request

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the details — congrats on the growth and the volume improvements. We're confident we can support a 16→32 upgrade with an updated reserved pricing and a throughput appendix to the SLA. I'll need to align a couple internal stakeholders on the final discount levels and the migration window.

Quick answers: 
- Timeline: we can plan a staged rollout with capacity visible in the next region within 3 weeks of contract signature; full traffic cutover can be scheduled over a 48–72 hour maintenance window.
- Migration support: we offer a one-time migration engagement (4 engineer-days) — I'll include options with/without the engagement.
- Provisional pricing and throughput proposal: sending internally and will follow up with a formal amendment doc and SLA appendix by 4/27.

Would a draft amendment and DocuSign-ready version work for procurement? If yes, I'll loop legal and our pricing owner.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Account Executive — Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26 08:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Altos — pricing for 16→32 upgrade + throughput SLA (need guidance)

Team — forwarding Altos' asks. Key points for your review:
- They want to move from 16→32 reserved GPUs at renewal (target 2027-06-01).
- Requesting a per-hour reserved rate to lock for a 12-month term.
- Asking to raise throughput commitment to ~220 tokens/sec (they previously had 120).

Provisional numbers I'd like to test with you before I send the amendment:
- List price (current): $3.20/hr per reserved GPU on 16-GPU commit
- Proposed base reserved price for 32-GPU commit: $2.85/hr per GPU (equates to ~11% blended discount on list)
- If they sign a 24-month term we can increase to $2.60/hr per GPU (deeper term commit)
- Throughput SLA appendix: guarantee 200 tokens/sec sustained at 95th percentile for the reserved pool, with an escalation/credit structure (if sustained below 95th pct then 5% service credit; below 90th pct then 10%). We can gate stronger guarantees to a 24mo term or additional burst capacity add-on.

Questions for you:
1) Legal: any special clauses we should add around throughput measurement (we use per-route tracing + sampling) — Dev, can you confirm telemetry definitions?
2) Commercial: Marissa, is the blended $2.85/hr acceptable as a first pass? Any flexibility on additional one-time migration fee (we could include 4 engineer-days pro bono to close)?
3) Ops: Vivek, timeline and risk for a June 1st cutover — does 3 weeks post-signature sound realistic?

I'll attach a draft amendment and a short SLA appendix with the telemetry spec in the next message.

- Monica
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-27 09:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Altos — pricing for 16→32 upgrade + throughput SLA (need guidance)

Thanks, Monica. Good framing. My thoughts: 
- Pricing: $2.85/hr is fine as the anchored commercial ask for a 12-month renewal. Offer a conditional commercial sweetener: waive the one-time migration fee (normally billed) if they commit to a 12-month term and agree to a 60% prepayment schedule (annual upfront or quarterly) — helps us with cashflow.
- Term: if they consider 24 months, we can price to $2.60/hr as you suggested, but only with an operational playbook signed off and a predictable monthly usage pattern (reduce risk of mid-term overage disputes).
- SLA/throughput: the 200 tokens/sec at 95th pct looks defensible; per Monica we should push 220 as an aspirational target but only commit to 200 guaranteed unless they take the 24mo commitment or add the burst pool.

I've attached the draft amendment (RIF_Amendment_16to32_v1.docx) and a short throughput appendix PDF. Please review and sign off. If everyone is aligned, Monica — send to Liam with the DocuSign link and we can request a PO from procurement.

-Marissa

Attachments: RIF_Amendment_16to32_v1.docx, throughput_sla_appendix.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@altosys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Mills <sara.mills@altosys.com>, procurement@altosys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30 16:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation — upgrade 16→32 GPUs (term + throughput adjustment)

Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft amendment. Procurement reviewed the costs and we're prepared to move forward under the following provisional terms: 
- 12-month renewal effective on signature with immediate billing on the 32-GPU reserved tier
- Agreed provisional per-hour reserved rate: $2.85/hr per GPU (ALT signs with the 12-month cadence and 60% upfront payment as requested)
- Throughput: Altos accepts the 200 tokens/sec at 95th pct guarantee as the contracted SLA; we will evaluate the 220 tokens/sec aspirational metric in Q3 and consider 24mo at that time
- Please include the migration engagement as waived in the amendment per Marissa's note

Next steps: please send a DocuSign-ready amendment and we will route to procurement for the PO and signature. Also include the SLA appendix and the HubSpot deal link in the DocuSign email so our legal/procurement team has the context.

Appreciate the responsiveness — aiming to have PO by 05/10.

Liam
